description: October 20 birthday meaning: Libra decan 3, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 20 birthday falls in Libra, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: October 20 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Gentle, verbal and finely tuned to others: the 20th of October often reads this way. Twenty-six degrees of Libra falls in the Mercury decan, so connection happens through conversation, and twenty reduces to 2, the number of partnership and receptivity. Both systems emphasise the other person, which tends to make this birthday a natural confidant, translator or go-between.

On October 20 the Sun usually sits at about 26° Libra, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. Mercury, ruler of Gemini, colours the final decan of Libra, which runs from around October 14 to October 23. The scales here are weighed with words. Mid-October birthdays are often described as articulate, sociable and quick to see both sides of an argument, sometimes simultaneously. Writing, negotiation, teaching and any role that depends on good conversation tend to suit them. Mercury can add restlessness and a habit of debating rather than deciding. When this decan commits to a view and explains it with Libra's courtesy, it can change minds that more forceful voices never reach.

sections.heading: October 20 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 20 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on October 20: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 20 is the 293rd day of the year (294th in a leap year). By October 24, 4 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 20 include Arthur Rimbaud (1854), Elfriede Jelinek (1946) and John Dewey (1859).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 20?
faq.answer: October 20 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Libra, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 20 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 20?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 20?
faq.answer: October 20 is also the birthday of Arthur Rimbaud (1854), Elfriede Jelinek (1946) and John Dewey (1859). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
